snippet.title: RMF's Ragdoll Physics Experiments – Official Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Experience the chaotic hilarity of RMF's Ragdoll Physics Experiments.
Wishlist here on Steam! 👉 https://bit.ly/rpxsteam

Bluee’s back. And so are the explosions, dodgy contraptions, and regrettable design decisions.

👉 https://bit.ly/RPE-KickStarter ← Hit “Notify me on launch” to support chaotic ragdoll mayhem! 🎯 

This teaser is your first look at the absurd sandbox where failing is the point. Slam into walls, fling yourself through fans, and get rewarded for falling apart — literally.

From the creators of Rate My Funerals, RMF’s Ragdoll Physics Experiments is a physics-driven game of slapstick experimentation, where every crash test becomes a comedy sketch.

🎯 Support the game’s launch on Kickstarter!
👉 https://bit.ly/RPE-KickStarter 👈
Click “Notify me on launch” and become one of the first OG backers.

👀 Stay weird with us:
